stats.strength: The raw power of your muscles. Determines how hard you hit for melee attacks, and improves your health to a lesser degree.
stats.constitution: How sturdy and durable your body is; how well you can withstand punishment. The main source of HP and stamina before bonuses and a core line of defense against status effects and critical hits.
stats.agility: Your ability to move quickly. Directly affects your hitting and dodging capability.
stats.affinity: Connection to the greater multiverse. Amplifies mystical effects across the board.
stats.capacity: Depth of your reserves of mystical energies.
stats.flow: How well your energy pathways conduct mystical energies. Improves cast speed and reduces cooldowns.
stats.ego: The degree to which you can impress your will upon the fabric of reality. Direct soul attacks and actions scale off of ego.
stats.resilience: Your resolve to withstand any challenge thrown at you. The base source of spirit.
stats.charm: The power of your mind to influence other minds. Also known as charisma, or manipulativeness, depending on who you ask.
stats.luck: How much fate bends around you. Directly multiplies drop rates and affects some other probabilistic events to varying degrees.
stats.talent: Your natural ability to gain power. Makes it easier to progress along most progression systems.
stats.comprehension: Your ability to learn, do, and gain insights. Determines how quickly you grasp skills, techniques, and arts.
stats.physical_attack: Base normal attack damage for physical attacks. Multiplied by each damage type for total physical damage.
stats.mystical_attack: Base attack damage of mystical attacks.
stats.soul_attack: Base attack damage of soul attacks.
stats.attack_power: Total damage dealt by a normal attack.
stats.attack_speed: How many normal attacks you can perform per second, other physical attack speeds scale off of this.
stats.cast_speed: How quickly you can cast abilities.
stats.defense: Reduces the damage you take from incoming attacks.
stats.defense_proportion: Reduces damage taken after defense by a proportion.
stats.hit_score: Your accuracy. Compared against the target's dodge score.
stats.dodge_score: Your evasiveness. Compared against the attacker's hit score.
stats.crit: Your observance and focus. Compared against the target's critical hit protection.
stats.crit_prot: Your cautiousness and protectiveness. Compared against the attacker's critical hit score.
stats.crit_mult: The multiplier your attacks are multiplied by upon triggering a critical hit.
stats.def_penetration: The amount of damage that bypasses defense to always reach your target.
stats.def_penetration_proportion: The proportion of damage that is guaranteed to hit your target. Incredibly difficult to increase.

description.g: Level up to increase your stats.
description.f: You're no longer a beginner anymore, but that just means the world seeks to punish your mistakes even more harshly.
description.e: Getting this far proves that you have what it takes to keep going. Unfortunately, all you have is the knowledge that going forward is the only way.
description.d: You may take a rest now, just remember that every moment wasted is one you will never get back.
description.c: Local threats can no longer challenge you anymore. You have to seek out the greater threats yourself.
description.b: Your footsteps have brought you somewhere most will never reach, but it's not them you have to worry about. It's what's ahead of you.
description.a: As one of the strongest of your world, you have the responsibility not only to protect but to advance.
description.s: You may be at the top of your world, but you know you haven't even witnessed anything close to true power.
description.ss: Beyond the confines of your world, everything is above you. Only you may reach towards the stars.
description.sss: Every boundary you cross feels unreachable; you reach past anyway. What is the top of a series is only the gateway to the next.
